summary: New Hailuo AI Video users registering on or after June 18, 2025 receive a one-time welcome package of credits, limited to one package per user. The credits expire three days after grant; the policy does not specify the package size or promise recurring free replenishment. Free-tier outputs are watermarked, with at most three video-generation tasks queued and one video generating at a time. Paid plans offer additional credits, watermark-free downloads and queue priority. No global end date is stated for the welcome offer.
claim_steps: Create a free account at hailuoai.video. The policy covers new registrations on or after June 18, 2025.
Receive the one-time welcome package on signup; only one package per user is allowed and the package size is not specified in the policy.
Use welcome credits within three days of grant, before they expire. Do not assume recurring free credit replenishment.
Generate videos from prompts or images within the free allowance, with at most three tasks queued and one video generating at a time. Free-tier downloads are watermarked.

social_proof.title: Hailuo AI — Payment Policy
social_proof.text: New users who register an account on or after June 18, 2025 will receive a one-time welcome package of free credits. These credits will expire three days after being granted. This offer is limited to one package per user.

social_proof.title: Hailuo AI — free-user generation queue limits
social_proof.text: Free users may submit up to three video generation tasks to the queue at any given time ... Free users are limited to generating one video at a time in parallel
